# Canvas Meteor Dodge

Control a ship at the bottom of the canvas and dodge falling meteors. Meteors spawn from random top positions and accelerate over time. The player loses when a meteor collides with the ship (or after 3 hits). Score increases with each avoided meteor; difficulty ramps up as the score rises. Simple 2D drawing, keyboard/mouse input, and collision detection are sufficient.
